blocks.value: Diversification means spreading your investments across different companies or asset types instead of putting all your money into one investment.
Imagine This: If you carry ten eggs in one basket and it falls, you may lose everything. If you divide the eggs into several baskets, one accident won't destroy them all.
By investing across different companies and sectors, poor performance from one investment may be balanced by better performance from others.
Instead of investing ₹1,00,000 in one company, an investor may spread it across banking, IT, pharma, FMCG and energy companies.
Diversification reduces risk, but it cannot eliminate it completely.
